body_html:
Give any workstation the flexibility of sit-stand without the assembly headache. This Newland 2-leg electric base ships with its beam, leg columns, and dual motors preassembled — you simply unfold the legs, lock them in place, and pair it with a top up to 76" wide. A digital controller with four memory positions lets every user dial in their ideal height in seconds.

Features

  • Quick assembly: beam and leg columns with motors arrive preassembled — unfold and lock
  • 3-stage, dual-motor electric base with 265 lbs lift capacity
  • Digital up-down controller with four programmable memory positions
  • Height range 21.6" to 47.2"H; fits worksurfaces 46" to 76" wide
  • Anti-collision sensor for safe, automatic stops
  • Quiet operation at 42 dB, raising and lowering at 1.2" per second
  • Energy-efficient: 0.1W standby / 220W active draw, with an 8' power cord
  • Available in Black, Designer White, and Tungsten finishes

Specifications

Base footprint measures 42.5"W x 22.8"D and weighs 77.2 lbs. Built by Global Furniture Group under the Newland line, it carries ANSI/BIFMA LEVEL and GREENGUARD Gold certification and is made in Canada.

Brant Business Interiors is a family-owned Canadian dealer in Peterborough, Ontario, and an OECM-eligible supplier — Ontario institutional buyers can purchase without an open tender. Request a Quote on this base or call 1-800-835-9565 to spec your sit-stand workstations.
